one_line: Show every piece of the product in use in quick fixed shots and end on one laugh.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 static wide shot: a child slides down a foam ramp beside a block with a round window. Small white text: "POV: הגמבורי הכי שווה נמצא אצלכם בבית". 0:02 a toddler pushes a large foam cylinder. No speech.
q1_hook.why: The text promises a clear benefit, a play gym at home, while a child already uses the product (H1, H2, S1). But the text is tiny and thin (T5), and there is no voice or face (H4, H6 not met), so the promise may be missed.

beats.what: A child slides down a foam ramp beside a block with a round window; the "POV" line
beats.why: Product in use and the promise in one frame

beats.what: A toddler in patterned pyjamas pushes a large white foam cylinder; tunnel and block behind
beats.why: A second piece, a new action

beats.what: A child's legs inside a fabric tunnel that leads into a tent
beats.why: Shows the tunnel and tent as part of the set

beats.what: The toddler crawls out beside the ramp and block, smiling
An adult in the tent reads a board book with the toddler; BLISS tag on the tent
beats.why: A calm use after the active ones

beats.what: An adult lying on the floor throws a white cloth, foam cubes around
beats.why: A short playful beat before the finish

beats.what: A man in a cap and the toddler stack foam cubes; the tower falls
beats.why: Ends on a shared laugh moment

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: None. There is no caption in the data, and no question, tag, save or send ask on screen.
q2_flow.why: A new piece or action every 2 to 3 s keeps the picture moving (R3, E2), and the tower falling in the last 2 s gives a laugh at the end (R4, K1). Information is missing: no piece is named and nothing says what the set contains (R3).

q3_cta.what: None in the video, and no caption in the data. The only brand sign is a small BLISS tag on the tent at 0:11 to 0:12.
q3_cta.why: No next step: nothing says where to buy, the price or the brand (C6, C7). A reach-only Reel can do without one, but it leaves the "at your home" promise with no follow-up.

q4_shown.what: Ramp and block with a round window (0:00), a large white foam cylinder (0:02), a fabric tunnel into a tent (0:06), a book read in the tent (0:11), foam cubes stacked by a man and the toddler (0:14). No price, name or size.
q4_shown.why: Five pieces are shown in use within 18 s, so the set reads as a whole play corner (S1, K5). A parent joining in adds warmth (K8). The product is never named or priced, and children's faces are on screen, which LumeBook's own Reels avoid (S5).

q5_edit.what: About 7 shots in 18 s, about 2.6 s each, straight cuts, all fixed camera positions. One small fixed text line for the whole Reel. No speech or subtitles. Ends on the cube tower falling at 0:17 to 0:18.
q5_edit.why: Fixed frames and a cut every 2 to 3 s are clear and calm (E2). The length fits one visual idea (R2) and it ends right on the laugh, no tail (E8, R4). Sound could not be checked and the text is tiny, so little carries a muted viewer (E4).

q6_topic.what: A promise that a foam play set brings the soft-play gym home, shown as a toddler using each piece. Serves parents who want indoor play space.
q6_topic.why: The line gives a clear benefit, a play gym at home, and the child's play backs it (H2, K5). It speaks to a parent's wish for indoor play (K6), but names no gift or occasion to send (K7, R5 not met).

q7_filmed.what: Fixed phone camera, wide and medium shots of the corner; a low static view of the tunnel opening and a close view into the tent. Bright even indoor light, plain wall, wooden floor. Two children, an adult's legs, a man in a cap.
q7_filmed.why: Fixed, clean framing against a plain wall makes each piece and action easy to read at phone size (F4, F7). Vertical, no borders (F1). A real home, not a studio (H8). The text sits at about 36% of the frame height, clear of the bottom 35% (F2), but is tiny.

q8_text.on_screen: One small thin white line, centred at about 36% of the frame height, 0:00 to 0:18, never changing: "POV: הגמבורי הכי שווה נמצא אצלכם בבית". The Latin "POV:" sits at the left end of the line. No subtitles, no CTA, no brand text.
q8_text.caption: None: the post has no caption in the data (media info lists a coauthor, bliss.il). So no hashtags, keywords, question, CTA or disclosure words.
q8_text.why: The line states the promise from the first frame (T3) in the safe zone (T4), but it is tiny and thin, white over beige (T5). The Latin "POV:" sits at the wrong end for a Hebrew reader (T6). With no caption there are no keywords, hashtags or disclosure words (T7, T8).

weak_points: Text too small to read; no caption, CTA, price or product name; the brand tag barely legible; nothing says what the set contains; the Latin label at the wrong end of the Hebrew line; children's faces on screen.
lumebook_takeaway: Film the book in use in six short fixed phone shots, hands only, with one large Hebrew promise line from frame one and a CTA at the end.
not_verified: Caption (none in the data); audio and music (the transcript is only "תודה רבה", which means no speech); whether the adults are the creator; whether all pieces are Bliss (a BLISS tag is legible only on the tent at 0:11). The first child and the later toddler look different (clothes, hair). The text line reads as one Hebrew sentence with "POV:" at the left end, checked on an enlarged frame.
